description:
We are a team of passionate and enthusiastic students interested in space exploration, science, technology, and innovation. Our goal is to explore real-world challenges using creativity, research, teamwork, and NASA's open-source data.

For this challenge, we aim to create an engaging digital storytelling experience about NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars, highlighting their history, purpose, and scientific significance.
summary:
Beyond Their Mission – A Space Heritage Museum

Beyond Their Mission is an interactive educational website developed to showcase NASA equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. The project features an engaging space-themed interface with destination-based exploration, mission stories, historical timelines, and an interactive space quiz.

Users can explore the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner rover, and Voyager 1 to learn about their missions, discoveries, and contributions to space exploration. The website also provides links to official NASA resources for further learning and research.

Our project addresses the challenge of making NASA's abandoned and retired space equipment more interesting and accessible through digital storytelling and interactive learning. Instead of allowing these machines to be forgotten, we highlight their scientific and historical importance.

This project is important because every machine sent into space represents human curiosity, innovation, and scientific progress. Even after their missions end, their stories continue to inspire future generations of explorers.
details:
Beyond Their Mission: A Space Heritage Museum

Beyond Their Mission is an interactive educational website that showcases NASA equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. It allows users to explore space artifacts such as the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner rover, and Voyager 1. Each artifact has a story explaining its mission, purpose, historical importance, and contribution to space exploration.

The website includes destination-based navigation, interactive mission stories, a historical timeline, and a space quiz to make learning more interesting. It benefits students, space enthusiasts, and the general public by presenting space history in a simple, engaging, and accessible way.

The intended impact is to create awareness about the scientific and historical value of space equipment, even after its mission has ended. It aims to inspire curiosity about space exploration and encourage future generations to learn more about science and technology.

Tools and technologies used:

  • HTML – to structure the website.
  • CSS – to design the layout, colours, and responsive appearance.
  • JavaScript – to add interactive features and functionality.
  • Visual Studio Code – for writing and editing the code.

The creative aspect of our project is presenting forgotten space equipment as exhibits in a virtual museum. Instead of simply listing technical information, we use storytelling and interactive activities to help visitors connect with each artifact.

While developing the project, we considered ease of navigation, a user-friendly design, educational value, mobile responsiveness, reliable NASA information, and accessibility for users with different levels of space knowledge. Our goal is to make the history of space exploration engaging and memorable.
